metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 1992 · Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
metas.description: Kevin is separated from his family again when he accidentally boards a flight to New York City during a Christmas trip to Miami. However he crosses paths with the same burglars, who now plan to rob a toy store on Christmas Eve.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1989 · Batman
metas.description: The Dark Knight of Gotham City begins his war on crime with his first major enemy being Jack Napier, a criminal who becomes the clownishly homicidal Joker.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2001 · O Brother, Where Art Thou?
metas.description: In the deep south during the 1930s, three escaped convicts search for hidden treasure while a relentless lawman pursues them.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2021 · Venom: Let There Be Carnage
metas.description: Eddie Brock attempts to reignite his career by interviewing serial killer Cletus Kasady, who becomes the host of the symbiote Carnage and escapes prison after a failed execution.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Thunderbolts*
metas.description: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, an unconventional team of antiheroes must go on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2021 · Cruella
metas.description: During the 1970s London punk rock revolution, young grifter Estella transforms herself into the raucous, revenge-bent Cruella de Vil.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2010 · The A-Team
metas.description: A group of Iraq War veterans look to clear their name with the U.S. Military, who suspect the four men of committing a crime for which they were framed.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2020 · Enola Holmes
metas.description: When Enola Holmes, Sherlock's sister, discovers her mother is missing, she endeavors to find her, becoming a super-sleuth in her own right as she outwits her famous brother and unravels a dangerous conspiracy.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 1995 · Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
metas.description: Ace Ventura, Pet Detective, returns from a spiritual quest to investigate the disappearance of a rare white bat, the sacred animal of a tribe in Africa.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1969 · Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
metas.description: In 1890s Wyoming, Butch Cassidy and The Sundance Kid lead a band of outlaws. When a train robbery goes wrong, they find themselves on the run with a posse hard on their heels..

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1980 · The Blues Brothers
metas.description: Jake Blues rejoins his brother Elwood after being released from prison, but the duo has just days to reunite their old R&B band and save the Catholic home where the two were raised, outrunning the police as they tear through Chicago.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2023 · The Killer
metas.description: Solitary, cold, methodical and unencumbered by scruples or regrets, a killer waits in the shadows, watching for his next target. Yet, the longer he waits, the more he thinks he's losing his mind, if not his cool.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2016 · Inferno
metas.description: When Robert Langdon wakes up in an Italian hospital with amnesia, he teams up with Dr. Sienna Brooks, and together they must race across Europe against the clock to foil a deadly global plot.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2021 · Army of the Dead
metas.description: Following a zombie outbreak in Las Vegas, a group of mercenaries take the ultimate gamble, venturing into the quarantine zone to pull off the greatest heist ever attempted.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1991 · Thelma & Louise
metas.description: An Arkansas waitress and a housewife shoot a rapist and take off in a '66 Thunderbird.
